title: Dwan 2013 systematic review: publication bias and outcome-reporting bias are distinct but overlapping missing-data layers
summary: A review-level meta-research record establishing that the file drawer is not one phenomenon: entire studies may go unpublished and measured outcomes may disappear or be incompletely reported inside published studies.
